$comment: Assay MCP server — drop this into your MCP client and ask it what is worth
reading on AWS Builder Center, or hand it your own draft for feedback.
Claude Desktop : merge the mcpServers block into claude_desktop_config.json
Claude Code    : claude mcp add assay -- /abs/path/.venv/bin/python -m shouldiread.mcp_server
Quick Suite    : use the remote entry below (SigV4, service bedrock-agentcore)
Replace /abs/path with wherever you cloned the repo.
Reads the deployed corpus from DynamoDB instead of a local run.
Needs AWS credentials with read access to the scores table.
Bedrock AgentCore Runtime, streamable HTTP MCP. Requests are SigV4-signed
against service name 'bedrock-agentcore'; the caller needs
See docs/connect-mcp.md for a worked signed request.
